recommendations.recommendation: Turn the heart to God, the only true rest for the restless soul.
recommendations.rationale: The heart is restless until it rests in God.

recommendations.recommendation: Confess your sins honestly and humbly before God.
recommendations.rationale: Self-knowledge and God's mercy come through confession.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not seek evil for its own sake, as in stealing for the thrill of wrongdoing.
recommendations.rationale: Gratuitous sin reveals the corruption of the will.

recommendations.recommendation: Restrain sensual lust and seek continence through God's grace.
recommendations.rationale: Lust enslaved the author until grace freed him.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not rely on your own strength; depend on divine grace.
recommendations.rationale: Human will alone failed the author.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid pride and vain curiosity about worldly knowledge for display.
recommendations.rationale: Pride separates the soul from God.

recommendations.recommendation: Reject false doctrines such as Manichaeism and astrology.
recommendations.rationale: They proved false and misled him.

recommendations.recommendation: Seek truth with faith first, so that understanding follows belief.
recommendations.rationale: Faith opens the way to understanding.
God is the source of all good.
